summary: Conditional session-phase-aware action dispatcher: guarded by the session-active flag dword_7D0350, decodes the current session phase, and when the action id a2 is in [7,10] stores the decoded phase at this+0x10 (if <= 5), dispatches GameActionStateMachine(this, a2, 0), sets the activity flag this+0x24 to 1, and runs ReciprocalWithSignCheck on flt_5EA4E8. Part of the pit-stop/session management path; called by PitStopReadyCheck.

operations.description: Session-active check: the body runs only when dword_7D0350 is non-zero.
Decode the current session phase: v3 = SessionPhaseDecode(this).
Action-id range check: the dispatch body runs only when a2 is in [7, 10].
Phase store: when the decoded phase v3 is <= 5, store it at this+0x10.
Dispatch the game action: GameActionStateMachine(this, a2, 0).
Set the activity flag at this+0x24 to 1.
Reciprocal computation on the global flt_5EA4E8: ReciprocalWithSignCheck(&flt_5EA4E8, 0.75).
